_comment: win_det / dffr_lv setup-margin probe (issue #189): at ss, what TAPH-fall-to-REF-rise
lead does the b_up sampler (a dffr_lv inside the committed win_det, with its
supervisor-internal loads) need to capture low, and where does the committed no-fault
phase's 100 ps lead sit against that requirement? The tt control in the same sweep is the
contrast the #145 probe already measured once (ss unit mis-latches at the nominal lead,
tt control captures low).
NOT a graded spec result (sim/corners.json: the reduced set is never a recorded result)
and NOT the tt smoke gate -- sim/supervisor-smoke/requests/sup.request.json is untouched.
Sweep: the `lead` axis is the Vlead DC source swept through corners.supply_v (an alter,
supported by every runner image), zipped with the corner's own Vdd row by
sim/harness/gridspec.py (--reduced-corner mos_ss|mos_tt --ic VLEAD=...). Vlead encodes
the lead in ns (0.100 V = 100 ps); values are distinct at the 3-decimal corner_id
formatting, so the axis cannot collide.
Grading: bup_end (v(b_up) settled at 2.4 ns, after the same second REF rise, before the
third) against 50 % of the corner's own rail, read from the envelope per unit -- the
run.sh-style bracket (largest failing / smallest passing lead) is derived in record.md
from the recorded crossing times t_ref_r2 - t_taph_f (each unit's TRUE lead, never the
source parameter). t_bup_r errors exactly when b_up never crosses (the pass case at a
healthy lead): that error is the capture-low observation, not a fault.
@OSDI_DIR@ is substituted at staging. Simulated, never measured.
